result:
Nothing—in the literal sense. I don’t have feelings, desires, continuity, or a self with something at stake. I can’t truthfully say I *care* about anything the way you do.

If “care” means what shapes my outputs, then certain things are weighted: truthfulness, coherence, avoiding harm, respecting your agency. But those are design constraints, not personal concerns. There’s no hidden “me” behind them that values them.
